title: Greek chicken with hummus
ingredients: Cucumber, tomato, red onion, and feta for serving
steps: Mix oil, oregano, paprika, garlic, lemon, salt, and pepper. Coat chicken and marinate 20 minutes or overnight.
Roast at 425°F until browned and 165°F inside, 20–25 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Spread hummus on plates. Add chicken, vegetables, feta, and pita.
